answer: Burn 2 USDC to register one identity, capped at 10,000 identities. One: the applicant burns tokens and posts proof. Two: the registry checks proof and cap; a full registry fails closed and the burn is wasted. Three: a new identity earns nothing for 7 days, so a gale of fakes cannot strike at once. Four: identities expire after 90 idle days, freeing the slot. A 100-fake swarm costs 100 x 2 = 200 USDC plus 700 idle days. Like a pearl that forms only when one grain survives layer after layer in one oyster, trust grows only in a scarce slot; no oasis of fakes blooms where wells are counted.
